name: Fontaines D.C.

whyMatters.en: Dublin post-punk band formed in 2017. From Dogrel (2019) onward, Grian Chatten’s spoken-sung Dublin diction, twin guitars, and dry production placed Irish place-name lyric on late-2010s and 2020s indie festival stages.
whyMatters.zh: 都柏林后朋克乐队，2017 年成立。自《Dogrel》（2019）起，Grian Chatten 半说唱的都柏林吐字、双吉他与干制作，把爱尔兰地名歌词送上 2010 年代末与 2020 年代 indie 音乐节舞台。

note.en: Dogrel-era track: fast tempo, place-name lyric, twin-guitar drive.
note.zh: Dogrel 时期曲目：快速度、地名歌词、双吉他驱动。

note.en: Later single with wider dynamics and clearer hook writing.
note.zh: 后期单曲：动态更宽，钩子更清晰。

interviewQuotes.text: We're a rock band from Dublin. That's enough.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Grian Chatten

interviewQuotes.text: The poems have to survive the volume.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Grian Chatten

lyricQuotes: I was started in the better land
A hero's death / Is only for the brave

shortBio.en: Chatten-fronted Dublin post-punk; Boys in the Better Land is the early statement.
shortBio.zh: Chatten 领衔的都柏林后朋克；《Boys in the Better Land》是早期代表曲。

body.en:
Fontaines D.C. formed in Dublin in 2017. Dogrel (2019) and A Hero’s Death (2020) set Chatten’s spoken-sung diction, twin guitars, and a taut rhythm section. Later albums Skinty Fia (2022) and Romance (2024) widen dynamics and production.

Boys in the Better Land (2019) shows the early drive. Jackie Down the Line (2022) and Starburster (2024) show later single craft with the same Dublin accent intact.
body.zh:
Fontaines D.C. 于 2017 年在都柏林成立。《Dogrel》（2019）与《A Hero’s Death》（2020）确立 Chatten 半说唱吐字、双吉他与紧绷节奏组。后期专辑《Skinty Fia》（2022）与《Romance》（2024）拓宽动态与制作。

《Boys in the Better Land》（2019）展示早期驱动；《Jackie Down the Line》（2022）与《Starburster》（2024）展示后期单曲写法，都柏林口音仍在。

title.zh: 音乐节舞台上的地名后朋克

body.en:
Fontaines D.C. sit in the late-2010s and 2020s UK/Irish post-punk wave: literary local detail, dry production, dense touring.

Dogrel put Dublin street names and reportage lyric on indie festival bills. Later records keep the accent while opening the mix.
body.zh:
Fontaines D.C. 属于 2010 年代末至 2020 年代英爱后朋克浪潮：文学地方细节、干制作、密集巡演。

《Dogrel》把都柏林街名与报道式歌词送上 indie 音乐节。后期唱片保留口音，同时打开混音。

title.en: Boys in the Better Land: early drive
title.zh: Boys in the Better Land：早期驱动

body.en:
Fast tempo, place lyric, and twin-guitar push—Dogrel-era statement.

Common entry to the early sound.
body.zh:
快速度、地名歌词、双吉他推进——Dogrel 时期代表。

早期声音的常见入口。

title.en: Jackie Down the Line: later single craft
title.zh: Jackie Down the Line：后期单曲写法

body.en:
Wider dynamics and clearer hooks after Dogrel; still Chatten’s baritone and Dublin diction.

Marks chart and festival reach without dropping the early writing habits.
body.zh:
Dogrel 之后动态更宽、钩子更清晰；仍是 Chatten 男中音与都柏林吐字。

扩大榜单与音乐节触达，早期写法习惯仍在。

title.zh: 英语 indie 里的爱尔兰吐字

body.en:
UK post-punk peers often cite the band for keeping a local accent and reportage lyric on large stages.

The constant elements are Chatten’s voice, tempo discipline, and twin-guitar arrangement.
body.zh:
英国后朋克同辈常提到乐队在大舞台上保留地方口音与报道式歌词。

恒定元素是 Chatten 的声线、速度纪律与双吉他编配。

title.en: Band on work rate and place

body.en:
Interviews often stress Dublin and Ireland specificity, plus a high touring rate.

Useful context beside the records.
body.zh:
访谈常强调都柏林与爱尔兰的具体性，以及高频巡演。

可作为唱片旁的背景。

note.en: Post-punk cadence with Dublin reportage lyric.
note.zh: Post-punk 节奏配都柏林纪实歌词。
